name: facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spatial_engine/utils/scannet_utils/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.batch_export_scannet_scenes: run batch_export to process multiple Scannet scans in parallel and save aligned points and labels as numpy files
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.export_single_scan: call export to load a single Scannet scene and return vertices, semantic labels, instance labels, and bounding boxes
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.export_one_scan_with_sampling: run export_one_scan to process one Scannet scan with optional point sampling and save results to an output folder
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.worker_multiprocessing: use worker as a multiprocessing target to process individual Scannet scans in parallel via Pool.map
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.main_cli_entry: run main to parse CLI arguments and batch export both train and test Scannet datasets

facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.run_extract_posed_images: run the script to extract RGB-D images, poses, and intrinsics from ScanNet .sens files
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.run_process_directory: run process_directory to parallel-extract posed images from all ScanNet scenes in a folder
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.create_SensorData: create a SensorData instance to load and parse a ScanNet .sens binary file with frame skipping
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.export_SensorData_images: export color images, depth images, camera poses, and intrinsics from a SensorData object
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.decompress_RGBDFrame: decompress depth data with zlib or color data with jpeg from an RGBDFrame instance

facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.run_split: run a split of ScanNet scenes to generate visibility info mapping images to 3D points in parallel
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.process_scene: process a single ScanNet scene to compute which points each image sees and invert the mapping
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.convert_pkl_to_parquet: convert a previously saved pickle visibility info file to a parquet file for efficient storage
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.create_visibility_mapping: create a bidirectional mapping between images and visible 3D points for all scenes in a ScanNet split
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.generate_scene_visibility: generate visibility information for train and val ScanNet splits and save as parquet files

facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.read_aggregation: read a ScanNet aggregation JSON file and return object-to-segments and label-to-segments mappings
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.read_segmentation: read a ScanNet segmentation JSON file and return segment-to-vertices mapping with vertex count
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.extract_bbox: extract bounding boxes and point clouds for each instance from mesh vertices and segment data
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.read_label_mapping: read a tab-delimited label mapping CSV file and return a category-to-NYU40 ID dictionary
facebookresearch_multi-spatialmllm/spati.read_mesh_vertices_rgb: read a PLY mesh file and return XYZ and RGB values for each vertex
